additional_info.subject: ID0444025-DC/Si-D/CH-[Y2/R3312881977020]Request for Raptor Report CRM:02681000639
additional_info.body:
Hello Alexander, good morning.
I checked this session and from start to finish, everything worked completely well. Unfortunately, we only have SCB logs, so no .pcap files to share, since it has been 2 weeks since the session.
Question from my side is, did the truck get completely inoperational? Is the truck parked and not working - waiting for a solution?
I will share here the complete story from that day for this EVID: "00.16.81.0e.eb.b4"
Start session:
After the start charging process, we see that the session runs for ~1h.
And here we can already see at the end of the log, EV_SOC = 100%. After this, we see the EV requesting a stop to us:
And then the StopTransaction:
2025-08-04T12:44:46.658567+00:00 [FW070005G1] sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/4a6ed965b241[739]: OCPP: Send command: StopTransaction (edcfeaa7-0a3c-43ff-9c38-2c1ee8f551ea) - {"meterStop":12839890,"timestamp":"2025-08-04T12:44:46.642Z","transactionData":[{"timestamp":"2025-08-04T12:44:46.642Z","sampledValue":[{"value":"100","location":"EV","unit":"Percent","measurand":"SoC"},{"value":"
99496
","location":"Outlet","unit":"Wh","context":"Transaction.End","measurand":"Energy.Active.Import.Interval"}]}],"transactionId":1409549565}
2025-08-04T12:44:46.852233+00:00 [FW070005G1] sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/4a6ed965b241[739]: OCPP: Received result: StopTransaction (edcfeaa7-0a3c-43ff-9c38-2c1ee8f551ea) - {"idTagInfo":{"status":"Accepted"}}
The energy transfered was:
99496
After this session successfully ended, the EV reattempted to restart a session at:
But failed since this charger doesn't have BCB toggle update.
After this failed attempt, the customer unplugged the EV and it didn't work again (from bottom to top):
After this day, there was never again a session performed with this EV.
I checked the sessions made on those days and I see that, without rebooting the charger, there was a brand new succesfull session on the 5th Aug:
So this also discards the possibility of a failure in the SECC (ecoG). Remember that before Authentication, the only component that is active is the SECC.
Please let me know what else you need from me or if everything is clear. Is this a similar case to the other one where the auxiliary battery got damaged?
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0444025-DC/Si-D/CH-[Y2/R3312881977020]Request for Raptor Report CRM:02681000639
additional_info.body:
Hello Alexander,
I assume that all Volvos are sold with the BCB toggle, this means that every Volvo in the world right now, will do this BCB toggle when it reaches 100%, as you can see, we stopped the session at 12:44:44pm and the Volvo reattempted at 4pm.
There must be some sort of logic where the EV checks his SoC and if it drops below a certain level, he reactivates and tries to charge again.
Since we don't have that update, he cannot begin the session. From my side, if you sell SiDs to a depot that uses Volvos, you should always request the update.
Still this is not a behaviour that should cause the EV to stop operating, we have many depots in Germany (where this whole story started) and this was never reported to us.
Does Volvo have a clear view on what got damaged?
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0444025-DC/Si-D/CH-[Y2/R3312881977020]Request for Raptor Report CRM:02681000639
additional_info.body:
Hello Alexander,
Sorry for the misunderstanding, you can request to us by creating a ticket and say that you want the hotfix for the BCB toggle or even better, the EcoG 1.4.12 update.
The idea here is to not ask Volvo for a downgrade. This is what we did in the past when we didn't have the BCB toggle update.
It's not a stupid question, I think it's my fault that I don't explain this in better detail since I already know what this is about. Please feel free to ask any kind of questions if you are not satisfied with my answers, I will gladly try to explain it better.
Please let me know the damage feedback.
Thanks again!
Best regards,
Francisco
